THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Order under Proviso (a) to Section 38
Order No. 07 of 2025
Ministry of Land Ref. No. : 4-3/5/2021/HW/347. Divisional Secretary’s Ref. No. : DSO/HOM/LAC/154.

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Live­stock, Land and Irrigation do hereby direct the Acquiring Officer or any other officer authorized by him referred to in paragraph 1 of the Schedule to take immediate possession of the land specified in the corresponding entry in paragraph 2 of that Schedule. K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, land and Irrigation.
Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Land Secreariate, No. 1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.08th January, 2025.
